decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt is a flagship extension of an established, popular organic range in a growing industry, so its results likely meet aspirations and give no trigger for problemistic search.

The mild sliced cheese is close to the firm's in-house cheesemaking core and has its own product page, and in a growing market the firm has enough slack to carry it while its early results are still uncertain.

The sliced butter cheese uses existing dairy capabilities at low incremental cost, so absent evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, management has little reason to divert its resources elsewhere.
